title: SPLIT SERIES PP-UL
desc: At its time of conception this was the greatest split I could create. It is backed by science I swear. Go check out the split series on the @smallsillyguy Instagram for more information.

ex.note: Warm up, set 1:start slow and stretch, focus on form over weight.set2: same stretch as the first, but add some intensity (weight/rep) set3:push to 10 reps, increase/lower weight if needed, FOCUS FORM
no WU, set1: deep stretch focus form pause @ bottom. set2: same as first but add reps, change weight if needed to accommodate for RPE and range. set3: same stretch, higher reps, USE ALL CHEST ENERGY
Warm up, set 1: as heavy as possible with good controlled slow form, really try to control the whole movement, set 2: everything about set 1 but better, slower, heavier, more stretched,
No wu, set 1: start with a high intensity, but do not sacrifice form, slow and controlled the entire time, sets 2&3:decrease weight and increase reps, if you can only get 8/12, that's ok, (drop set)

Warm up(3 reps) sets 1&2: feel the stretch through the entire movement, slow and controlled, lower weight if needed. set3: increase set2 weight by 5 and keep same form low rep is ok, strong full chest
warm up, set1: slow and controlled through the whole set.set2: increase reps don't loose form, set3: slower and more intense that 2 same weight. set4: up weight lower rep if needed focus form first.
No wu, set 1: slow and controlled, find a good weight, then move on. set2: everything good about set on but up weight. set3: up weight if needed or lower increase reps do not loose form. slow control
no wu, set1: start light and slow. set2: increase weight and reps. set3: slower than set 2, really give everything you have, fully stretching and making the most of the last set. FOCUS FORM
Warm up and find a good weight. Set 1: focus on slow, squeezed, fully worked reps. Make sure to hit the RPE & rep range. Set 2&3 same form focus with intensity changes depending on RPE & reps
Focus form and use lower weight if needed (1-2) second pause @ top of rep, focus on the squeeze over anything else.
burn all energy left in the biceps. 5 assisted reps of 5-second negative after 5-8 reps of non-assisted, set 2 completely optional depending on energy left in the tank. focus form and feel over all.
no warm up, set1: slow controlled same weight as set2 &3 set2&3: feel the weihght really strech and warm up your knees this is not meant to do anything but prep for an intense quad day.
No warm-up, set 1: start slow, get a deep stretch, & warm up the quads. Find a good weight to work up from, set 2: same weight as set 1, just up reps, & keep the intensity. set3: up weight same reps
No warmup, set 1: load some heavy weights and feel out the day. This is the most important set. set 2: maintain weight, focus on stretch & good form, pause at the bottom. set3: perfect form & rpe9.
pause @ top of set for about 1-2 seconds, fully squeeze and find failure towards the later sets.
slow and controlled reps fully contracting and squeezing throughout the entire set.
Go hard, feel the muscle, make sure to actually feel everything. Don't waste this
Warm up, set 1. Start light with perfect form, squeeze and slow decentric, set 2. increase weight, decrease reps. set3-4 increase reps and keep weight the same. Try to really squeeze the rear delts.
Lower the seat and have a higher arm position; this is to target the upper chest. set1. lower reps and find a nice weight to really squeeze through. sets 2-3. increase reps and keep the form.
Focus on hypertrophy and lower weight, higher reps. Try to focus entirely on your rear delts if possible. Squeeze, go slow, and control the weight the entire time. control over weight.
squeeze the bicep as much as possible really try to feel the best pump possible. lower weight, higher rep if needed to really promote as much growth as possible.
Go slow and controlled through the whole exercise. Make sure you are really squeezing the core and crunching as much as possible.
Really try to work the obliques here. squeeze through the entire exercise and make sure to really feel a good pump within the core. These will also help with mobility, so go slow and use them.
warm up. set1-2. slow tempo pause @ top and squeeze the entire time. set3. increase weight and keep form, really push hard to warm up the hamstrings.

Warm up and find weight set 1: slow and controlled, make sure to pause @ the bottom & focus RPE. set2. increase weight & maintain form. set3-4. Increase reps & weight depending on RPE. FEEL THE GLUTE.
no wu. set1. slow and perfect form. Start with a lower weight. set2. increase weight, keep form, feel these throughout the whole hamstring. set3. Increase reps and weight to fit the RPE. focus form.
no wu. set1. lighter weight and really make sure to feel the entire set. set2. increase weight and maintain form, lower reps if needed to fit the RPE. Focus on the feel over anything.
Go hard, feel the muscle, make sure to actually feel everything. Don't waste this
